goal: Validate Student 5 Release 1 MCP and RAG integration: the shared MCP server's read-only budget tools, the shared RAG server's grounded and insufficient-context answers for feature student-5, and the Student 5 backend routes that call both
_note: Local run only; needs host AI-Mode, RAG and MCP plus the Compose stack. Set SERVICE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8085 BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18005 MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8012 RAG_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8011 CHECKS_FILE=checks/student-5-release-1.json. All checks are read-only.

rules: Student 5 MCP tools are read-only: budgets_list, budgets_get_summary and expenses_list call only the Student 5 public API with GET.
An unavailable provider cost is reported as unavailable and the summary is incomplete; it is never treated as zero.
RAG confidence is calculated by the RAG server from retrieval scores; an insufficient-context answer has no citations.
The browser never calls MCP or RAG directly; the Student 5 backend fixes the RAG feature, top_k, MCP tool name and tool arguments.
